name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Lifetime Achievement
briefDescription: The Vayoshreshtha Samman: Lifetime Achievement Award honors eminent senior citizens for significant contributions to the field of ageing and the welfare of elderly, especially indigent seniors.
descriptionMd: The National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Lifetime Achievement is conferred to eminent and outstanding senior citizens. This award recognizes their significant contributions in the field of ageing and for the cause of elderly persons, especially indigent senior citizens, promoting their welfare.
benefitsMd:
- Recognition as an eminent and outstanding senior citizen.
- Honor for significant contributions to the field of ageing and welfare of the elderly.
eligibilityMd:
- The nominee must be an eminent and outstanding senior citizen.
- Nominees are preferably above seventy years of age.
- Nominees must have worked in the field of ageing.
- Nominees must have made significant contributions for the cause of elderly persons, especially indigent senior citizens.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
